svg.aria-label: Relay drawn as a machine on a bench. Three trigger chutes drop tokens into an intake manifold. A pinned cam drum, one of five interchangeable cartridges kept in a rack behind it, steps the run forward on a ratchet that never turns back. A follower pushes each tool call, the lit shuttle, along a rail through a policy gate with an allowlist card, a taint flag and a human-approval key lock. A flyball governor with four budget meters can brake the drum, and a twelve-slot stuck detector trips when three identical actions repeat. The rail ends in an airlock on a sealed glovebox whose only exit is a filtered egress stack on top.
svg.text: triggers → sequencer → policy gate → sealed sandbox
